1935, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO.6.
Page 31 Cont.
Aug. 26 John Sarbinowski - 29 - Threatened with T.B. has wife and child. 27 Mrs. Johanna Ryan - 71 - diabetes A.A. Riker - 39 - Tuberculosis of spine Jacob Nett - 64 - Heart & Hi. Bl. away from Sacraments 25 yrs.
Page 32
Aug. 27 Lenore Roop - 24 - T.B. Herm - K. Hospital. Joseph A. Stockler of Wyomissing Pa. - heart and lung trouble ...
28 Mrs. M. Mellon - 50 (?) - anxious to pay honest debts. Had store in mining town. Mines shut down. Lost heavily herself but suc- ceeded in paying all debts except two (50)
Mrs. P ... 67 ... 2 sev. strokes. here To-day.
Page 33 Aug. 29 Eileen Schommer - 17 - becoming sadly wayward ....
Francis Dalton - 35 - with wife and 3 struggling on. Sometime dis- couraged - want steady employment.
31 Lenora Mrs. M. Boden - 46 - internal cancer.
Cyril DeUriendt - 47 - stomach cancer - given up by doctors three mos. ago - to live but a few weeks. Away from holy sacraments about 15 yrs. - wife also careless - son sick too but trying to get them back to religion.
1935, September
Sep. 3 Mrs. Kathleen Olson - 31 - Ether-pneumonia from operation an appendix ... Ethel Wenz - 36 - husband & 2 for School - trying to escape T.B.
4 Anthony Wieczorek - 23 - Seminarian in 2nd Philosophy - T.B. now in Northville.
